summary: A 10-by-10-foot wooden cab on a rock crib, built in 1926 in Lemhi County; unstaffed since the 1940s, still standing, and registered in 2020.

resolved_conflicts.explanation: Idaho Fire Lookouts uses 'Abandoned' for the 1940s and does not say the tower is gone; the register and firelookout.com say it still stands. The record's conflict entry reading 'gone' does not match that page.
firelookout.com says Salmon National Forest; the register says Salmon-Challis National Forest. The story uses the register's name.

notes_for_editor: Medium confidence. Disagreements left open: ground cabin (register) vs two-story log cab (Idaho Fire Lookouts); wood frame vs log; elevation 9,604 ft / 2,927 m (register) vs 9592 ft (firelookout.com and Idaho Fire Lookouts). The record keeps kind 'ground' per the register. The 1934-36 staffing rests on a history site quoting 1930s newspapers; the 1935-36 items say 'LaSal mountain' and the page files them under Sal Mountain, but no source confirms that link directly. No source describes the current condition or public access. The record's conflict value 'gone' (idaho_fl) appears to be a misreading of 'Abandoned'.
